questions.title: Survivor: podcast edition
questions.prompt: Nathan's Noodle podcast had a built-in elimination system. What would happen to members who turned out to be bad on the mic?
options: They would pay for the next recording session
They would be forced onto the production team
They would become the show's anonymous callers
They would have to host a solo apology episode
questions.explanation: One by one, the weak performers would be moved behind the scenes. Nathan named it exclusioncast; Jimmy predicted the excluded members would make a better podcast of their own.

receipts.text: Imagine noodle podcast but we collectively weeded out who was good at it and who was bad at it and one by one forced the bad ones onto the production team
And called it exclusioncast
But then the exclusion cast made their own podcast that was better than the main

questions.title: A challenging phone screen

Getting his car through a wash
Finishing a set of squats
Escaping a barber's chair
